words.trans: adj. 宽松下垂的、肥大的（衣服太大不贴身）
examples: He threaded his stick down inside one of the baggy legs.

words.trans: 宽大肥阔的裤腿；legs 此处指连体防寒服的裤腿
examples: He pulled the quilted suit on, threading his walking stick down one baggy leg.

words.trans: n. 盆栽植物（英式常用；美式更多说 houseplants）
examples: The hallway had pot plants and pictures on the walls.

words.trans: adj./n. 叮当声、叮叮作响的（玻璃、金属等轻而清脆的连续响声）
examples: There was a tinkling of glasses down the passage.

words.trans: 把 A 和 B 做对比、拿 A 与 B 相较
examples: Compare that, for example, to a second-hand Rapier.

words.trans: 弄到、获取、搞到手；抓住。核心是“拿到、弄到”，隐含一层：不是随手就能拿到，需要费点劲才能够获得
examples: If you can get hold of one, you'll agree it makes sense.

words.trans: n.（楼梯的）平台、楼梯休息平台（两段台阶之间的平地）
examples: Tom came to a landing halfway down the stairs.

words.trans: 一整段连续的台阶（a flight of stairs/steps 一段楼梯）
examples: He came to another arrow pointing down a further flight of steps.

words.trans: 远非、完全不；离……很远。强调“事实和预想完全相反”，非但没有……反而……，带惊讶感
examples: Far from leading to an exit, the arrows took him below ground.

words.trans: v.（本章义）身体瘫软、垮下来；（纸张）揉皱；（面部）皱起
examples: He almost crumpled in despair when he saw a tiny square chamber.

words.trans: n. 房间、密室、小室（文学/正式用词；心脏的“腔”也用此词）
examples: He flicked on a light and saw a tiny square chamber.

words.trans: n. 死胡同、绝境、走不通的路（没有出口的路或境地）
examples: It was doorless and windowless - a hopeless dead end.

words.trans: adv. 纵向地、沿着长边方向（长边朝前/朝下摆放）。也拼 lengthwise
examples: A metal chest about the size of a fridge, laid lengthways.

words.trans: n. 惩罚、报应（偏书面、正式，多指恶有恶报，带正义惩戒意味）。swift retribution 迅速的报应
examples: He would tell Rufus Clay everything, and swift retribution would follow.

words.trans: （英式，美式多用 putter around）慢悠悠地闲逛、不紧不慢地忙活琐事，轻松随意做点零碎杂事，没有紧迫目的
examples: Aunt Emily pottering about with a duster in her hand.

words.trans: n. 除尘掸、抹布、擦灰布
examples: Aunt Emily pottering about with a duster in her hand.

words.trans: （空间/时间）在前方绵延铺开；（时间）还很长、徐徐展现在眼前
examples: Saturday afternoon stretching ahead.

words.trans: v.（气味、烟雾、风）缓缓飘送、飘荡。waft 专描轻的东西缓慢流动（香气、薄雾、微风轻柔地飘），不是猛地冲过来。wafting up 向上飘来
examples: The herby scent of lake water wafting up through the floorboards.

words.trans: （事件、局面）发生、展开、一步步发展、上演
examples: He could see how everything was going to play out.

words.trans: v. 宣布、宣告（官方作出判定、得出结论）。pronounce somebody + 状态：pronounce him missing/dead 官方经认定后判定失踪/宣告死亡。重点：有“认定、下结论”的过程；announce 只是对外发布消息，不一定核实或做了法律层面的判定
examples: He would probably be pronounced missing rather than dead.

words.trans: 一点点、零星的一小段（声音、文字、信息）
examples: He was surprised to hear a scrap of cheerful conversation.

words.trans: adj. 欢快的、兴高采烈的；轻松愉快的。形容情绪、语气愉快，不一定是大声欢呼
examples: He heard a scrap of cheerful conversation.

words.trans: （口语）住嘴、别讲了。比 shut up 稍柔和一点，但仍不客气，不是礼貌用语
examples: Shut it! It is a long way down here.

words.trans: 一步步给某人讲解、带着某人过完整个流程；引导某人做完一件事。talk sb through sth
examples: I will talk you through the escape plan.

words.trans: 缓过气来、恢复呼吸（剧烈跑动/劳累之后）
examples: When you have got your breath back, I will talk you through it.

words.trans: 继续说、往下讲（催促对方继续往下说）
examples: Go on, soldier, I am all ears.

words.trans: 固定习语：洗耳恭听、我认真听着呢，不只是简单“我在听”。语感：很感兴趣、专心等着听你往下说，带着期待
examples: Go on, soldier, I am all ears.

words.trans: 后脑勺（head 后面的部位）
examples: The door pushed back into Tom's nose, back of his head squashed against the wall.

words.trans: v. 压扁、挤压；被紧紧抵住、塞紧（squashed against the wall 被紧紧抵在墙上）
examples: The back of his head was squashed against the wall.

words.trans: 四处翻找、到处搜查（随便翻来翻去查看）
examples: When they poke around, it will look like a factory fire.

words.trans: 名词：（慢慢）累积起来的量、积聚；build up 的名词形式。build-up of gas 气体积聚、瓦斯蓄积
examples: It looked like a fire caused by a build-up of gas.

words.trans: （英式口语）逗留、徘徊、待着不走
examples: If you hang about upstairs you'll be toast.

words.trans: 习语：完蛋了、要遭殃、必死无疑（烤成吐司→被“烤熟”、死定了）
examples: If you hang about upstairs you'll be toast.

words.trans: 最后的应急手段、万不得已才动用的办法；last resort = 最后一招、不得已的手段，stuff 泛指这类东西/方案
examples: This is last-resort stuff, mate. It won't happen.

words.trans: 这里 hang on 不是“等一下”，而是 hinge on / hang on sth：取决于、系于这件事、成败都押在它上面
examples: There must be twenty million hanging on it.

words.trans: 那一群人、那帮人（英式口语，中性略带随意感；the lot of them 他们一帮人）
examples: Looking at that lot of customers upstairs.

words.trans: adv. 曲折地、迂回地、缓慢又别扭地（像蛇行一样弯弯曲曲、极慢地）
examples: Tortuously slowly the bead of sweat began to roll over his skin.

words.trans: n. 水肺（水下呼吸装置；self-contained underwater breathing apparatus 的缩略）
examples: He checked the scuba carefully.

words.trans: 水肺装备、潜水全套装备（氧气瓶、呼吸嘴、面罩等整套潜水器材）
examples: We get the scuba gear out of the chest and put it on.

words.trans: n. 净空高度、上方空余空间（工程术语；头顶以上可供通过的空间）
examples: Sometimes there's headroom, but sometimes the tunnel's full.

words.trans: 漆黑一片、伸手不见五指（固定短语）。pitch 本义沥青、沥青纯黑，pitch darkness = pitch-black darkness
examples: We'll be swimming underwater in pitch darkness.

words.trans: 习语：一动不动、一点都不敢动（连一块肌肉都不敢动）
examples: He was desperate to wipe it away but he could not move a muscle.

words.trans: n. 小球、液滴、小圆珠（文学用词，圆滚滚的一小滴）
examples: That dangling globule of sweat was all Tom could think about.

words.trans: adj. 非理性的、没有理性的、毫无来由的（irrational fear 无缘无故的恐惧）
examples: In the irrational, paralysing fear of the moment, he imagined it falling.

words.trans: n. 平煎盘、铁板烤盘（厚平底铁板，烙薄饼、煎东西用）
examples: Like a drop of water on a hot griddle, steaming and hissing.

words.trans: n. 渡槽、输水渠、大型引水管道。专指输送干净水的大型输水廊道（古罗马著名的即 aqueduct 高架渡槽；现代也指大型地下输水隧道）。区分：sewer 是污水下水道、排脏水的
examples: The farm sat above the route of the Thirlmere Aqueduct.

words.trans: 溢流管。overflow 溢出 + pipe 管道：水位太高时水从此管流出防溢水；不是一直通水，是水位超限时才走水
examples: The escape route is an overflow pipe.

words.trans: n. 涵洞（埋在路或堤坝下、让水穿过的通道，短的地下过水构筑物）。与 aqueduct 区分：aqueduct 长距离输水渠；culvert 一般较短、横穿道路的过水洞
examples: An overflow pipe that comes out through a culvert into the river.

words.trans: v. 淹没、浸没、沉入水中（be submerged 被淹没在水下）
examples: The outflow comes out through a metal gate, which is completely submerged.

words.trans: v. 拉开插销、解开门闩（latch 门闩，un- 反义）
examples: Whoever's first at the bottom of the culvert needs to unlatch it.

words.trans: （河流、水道）汇入、流入（更大的水体）
examples: The river that drains into the north end of the lake.

words.trans: n. 角磨机（手持电动砂轮切割机）
examples: Long time since I've used an underwater angle grinder.

words.trans: 带上水肺装备下潜、用水肺潜水往下走
examples: Then we scuba down to the river mouth.

words.trans: 法语短语：再见（带“后会有期、咱们回头见”的感觉），不是简单的 bye
examples: Then it's au revoir England for a while!

words.trans: n. 敬畏、惊叹（可褒义赞叹，也可又惊又怕的震撼）。a sense of awe 一种敬畏感
examples: He could not help feel a sense of awe at the terrible genius of Rufus Clay.

words.trans: 英式口语短语：絮絮叨叨、没完没了地啰嗦、东拉西扯说一堆没营养的话
examples: It was another chance to waffle on about those ingenious Victorians.

words.trans: adj. 构思巧妙的、有独创性的（形容人、方案、工程精巧）
examples: Those ingenious Victorians, hewing rock with nothing but pickaxes.

words.trans: v.（hewed/hewn，用斧头、镐子）砍、凿、劈、开凿岩石
examples: Hewing rock with nothing but pickaxes.

words.trans: n. 镐、十字镐（一头尖一头扁的那种开山镐）
examples: Hewing rock with nothing but pickaxes.

words.trans: n. 主干道、动脉（比喻交通/水流的“大动脉”）
examples: This artery of silent black water under his feet was the stuff of nightmares.
